body.summary: In Night City, a violent free-market metropolis in the Cyberpunk 2077 setting, street kid David Martinez survives a drive-by shooting that kills his mother and has a military-grade Sandevistan implant, taken from a dead cyborg, grafted onto his spine. He joins the crew of the edgerunner Maine, becomes a rising mercenary, falls for the netrunner Lucy, and takes on ever more chrome until cyberpsychosis sets in. After Maine's death and a massacre at Arasaka Tower, David is hunted by the corporation and dies fighting Adam Smasher while Lucy escapes to the Moon. ||The series ends with David dead, Lucy on the lunar surface, and a montage of the crew's survivors.||

arcs.summary: David loses his mother, gains the Sandevistan, and is taken in by Maine's crew, learning the edgerunner trade.
David rises in the crew and begins a romance with Lucy while her Arasaka past closes in.
Maine succumbs to cyberpsychosis and dies; David inherits leadership and the chrome habit.
Faraday and Kiwi betray the crew; David storms Arasaka Tower and dies fighting Adam Smasher while Lucy reaches the Moon.

notable_scenes.summary: Gloria dies in a drive-by crossfire and David is left with her ashes and the stolen Sandevistan.
David first activates the Sandevistan to survive a gang ambush.
Maine's cyberpsychosis overtakes him and Dorio dies; David puts him down.
David and Lucy share a braindance of her childhood and the Moon.
Kiwi's betrayal sends the crew into an Arasaka trap.
David fights Adam Smasher in Arasaka Tower and is killed.
Lucy walks on the Moon and sees David's recorded message.
